summary: suggestions.placement: 'message' shows the model's follow-up questions as buttons under the latest answer (heading 'Ask next') instead of the rotating chip above the composer; hidden while a turn runs, an approval or clarification is open, or after a stop or error.
howTo: suggestions={{ placement: 'message', count: 3 }}. The SuggestionBar and staticChips are not shown then; use composer.starters for an empty chat. Server follow-ups require pipeline: createAiChatHandler registers suggest_followups only with followups and pipeline and warns once at creation when followups is set without pipeline; without them the UI reads a trailing suggestion list of the answer. Heading text: followUpsLabel.
